notas: Structure read from a document filed after the date (study 1 behaviour, amendment 8)

materialidade_comparativo.texto: Highlighted: differences in totals and key lines (total assets, current liabilities, non-current liabilities, equity, net revenue, net income and operating cash flow) above 1% of total assets of the version used. The other differences (reclassifications between lines and smaller differences) stay in the full list.

o_que_se_sabia.nota: DFP and FCA filed with the CVM by the reference date; ITR comes in a later phase.

fatos_e_comunicados.nota: Material facts and market notices filed with the CVM by the date, from the IPE open data (since 2010): filing date, category, subject (as filed, in Portuguese) and link. The content of the documents is not downloaded, read or summarized, and the list generates no alert, score or ranking. The counts are of documents: versions, resubmissions and English versions count separately; in the list, versions of the same document and documents with the same date, category and subject appear on a single line, with a link to each one.

limites: No alert is not a clean bill of health. In Dechow, Sloan and Sweeney (1995), the most powerful accruals model rejected 'no manipulation' for only 28.1% of 32 companies sanctioned by the SEC (Table 7, p. 32).

In study 1, 49.9% of evaluated non-financial company-years (48.3% including financial companies) were in alert, and the number of detections did not beat chance in a descriptive test done after the result: 7 detections in 13 detectable cases, against 7.37 expected by chance without assuming independent years (8.56 assuming independent years).
Risk models use numbers that may be manipulated (Pereira and Martins 2015, p. 29). That is why the three families are not added up.
